summary: Discussion signals show major vendor moves (OpenAI wallet, Anthropic Projects), multiple marketplace/security alarms (Cursor), and operator-focused tooling/workflows (OpenCode, MCP memory, sandboxing). Prioritize vendor advisories and operator-safety checks. | Compressed vendor-only snapshot: high-priority security advisories (GHSA), vendor product releases (Mistral, OpenAI, Cloudflare), and operator-facing how-tos (AWS, Modal, Cursor). Prioritize patching/mitigation, model-routing and sandboxing patterns, and open-weight model rollout. | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple vendor releases (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel, Langflow/Dify) plus growing infra primitives (deja-vu, ECC) and operator guidance from GitHub blog/changelogs. Many repo-first signals need secondary social/usage corroboration. | Packaged-component snapshot: mix of mainstream VS Code/docker vendor packages and many single-repo infra primitives (MCP, eval, sandbox, memory). No social/operator reports in this shard; many PyPI/Crates-only items need corroboration.
